SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC.title: Heirloom Jade
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC.flavor: A family heirloom, gentle as jade, turning peril into peace.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_TIAN_LEI_REN.title: Thunder Blade
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_TIAN_LEI_REN.descriptio: On pickup, transform up to 5 cards into Lightning Slash.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_TIAN_LEI_REN.flavor: Nine heavens' thunder poured into the edge; where it falls, heaven's judgment follows.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_ZHU_QUE_YU_SHAN.title: Vermilion Feather Fan
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_ZHU_QUE_YU_SHAN.descrip: On pickup, transform up to 5 cards into Flame Slash.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_ZHU_QUE_YU_SHAN.flavor: One gentle wave, and the southern fire comes surging from the ribs of the fan.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_SHUI_BO_JIAN.title: Ripple Sword
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_SHUI_BO_JIAN.descriptio: At the start of each combat, gain 4 Regeneration.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_SHUI_BO_JIAN.flavor: Its light is like autumn water; wounds close in ripples.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_HONG_DUAN_QIANG.title: Crimson Tassel Spear
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_HONG_DUAN_QIANG.descrip: After every 2 normal combats, upgrade a random card.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_HONG_DUAN_QIANG.flavor: Its tassel is blood-red; each battle leaves the edge a little keener.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_HUN_DU_WAN_BI.title: Venom-Blend Curved Dagger
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_HUN_DU_WAN_BI.descripti: Whenever you play an Attack during your turn, temporarily gain 1 Strength.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_HUN_DU_WAN_BI.flavor: A blade steeped in venom — to draw blood is to deliver death.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_LIE_CUI_DAO.title: Quenched Blade
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_LIE_CUI_DAO.description: The first time each turn you deal damage to an enemy, that damage is doubled.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_LIE_CUI_DAO.flavor: From furnace to cold spring in one breath; quenched once, it ends a fight in one stroke.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_DUAN_ZAO_TAI.title: Forge Table
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_DUAN_ZAO_TAI.descriptio: On pickup, upgrade 5 random Attack cards.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_DUAN_ZAO_TAI.flavor: The anvil never rests; common steel becomes a keen edge.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_RONG_LU.title: Furnace
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_RONG_LU.description: On pickup, remove 1 card from your deck and gain 250 gold.
SGS_MOD_V3_RELIC_RONG_LU.flavor: Its fire lights heaven and earth; even scrap melts into gold.
